What YOUR WORLD is

One community, three directions of growth

YOUR WORLD is an online community for people who want to improve their life — their health and physical training, their finances, and their network — by surrounding themselves with people working toward the same things.

Health & Combat Sport

Connect with people training seriously — from general fitness to combat sports — and swap what's actually working.

Financial Growth

Talk income, business, and investing with members who are building the same way — with the reminder that nothing here is professional financial advice.

Networking & Opportunity

Meet like-minded people, hire or get hired, find teammates, and build the relationships that move your goals forward.

YOUR WORLD Networking Community

Where the networking actually happens

The YOUR WORLD Community is the heart of it all — the place to network with other members, hire people or get hired, ask for help and offer it, build teams, and meet people working toward goals like yours.

  • Network with like-minded members from around the world
  • Hire, get hired, or find partners to build with
  • Ask questions, share ideas, and get support from the group
  • Completely free to join — no cost to be part of the community

The YOUR WORLD Planner

Run your business day to day, in one tab

The Planner is a free tool built to help members scale their business without juggling five different apps — your schedule, your notes, your clients, and your moodboards, all in one place.

1

Today & Upcoming

See your Google Calendar synced straight into the app, and keep a running to-do list you can check off as you go.

2

Notes

Jot things down inside the app so you don't have to switch to a separate notepad.

3

Clients

Every client gets their own dossier and ID — name, email, phone, and address, searchable by name or ID, with a timestamped record of what's been sent.

4

Moodboards

Build visual moodboards for your business without leaving the app.

5

Network

One click through to the YOUR WORLD Community to keep networking.
